integrity: An algebraic proof supplies the infinite-field assertion, while exact enumeration in six prime fields and three quadratic fields corroborates finite cases. The general even-eight-cover theory is acknowledged as prior.
scientific_limitations: The exact quotient and orbit-set count concern q congruent to 1 modulo 8, not an unqualified formula for all fields. The formula does not count individual orbits, establish their transitivity, or give a closed zeta function for W. Older unindexed descriptions could imply the character sum; independent audit not performed.
title: An exact quadratic-character zeta twist for an eight-nodal Markoff K3 double cover
